spans.s:
f. (-वा)
1 A mare.
2 A female slave.
3 The nymph AŚVINĪ, or the personified asterism which is designated by a horse's head.
E.
बल strength or force, and वा to go to, affs. क and टाप्, and ल changed to ड.

m. (-वः)
1 Submarine fine.
2 A Brahman.
n. (-वं)
A stud, a collection of mares.
E.
बाडव a mare, and अण् aff. of derivation: see बडवानल.

m. (-ग्निः)
Submarine fire: see the next.
E.
बडवा a mare, and अग्नि.

m. (-ग्निः)
Hell.
E.
बडवाग्नि submarine fire, and अण् aff. of place.

m. (-लः)
Submarine fire; in mythology, a being consisting of flame, but with the head of a mare, who sprang from the thighs of ŪRVA, and was received by the ocean.
E.
बडवा a mare, and अनल fire.

m. (-तः)
The gallant of a female slave, and thence also a slave.
E.
वडवा, and हृत taken.

m. (-खः)
Submarine fire: see बडवानल.
n. (-लं)
The infernal regions.
E.
बडवा a mare, and मुख head, principal.

m. dual. (-तौ)
The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and the physicians of heaven.
E.
बडवा the nymph AŚVINĪ, and सुत a son.

(ऋ) बाडृ r. 1st cl. (-बाडते)
To bathe, to dive and emerge. Vopadeva differs from other authorities in writing this with an initial व.

m. du. (-यौ)
The two sons of AŚVINĪ and physicians of Svarga.
E.
बडवा a mare, Saṃjñā changed into a mare, and ढक् aff. of descent.

n. (-व्यं)
A number of Brahmans.
E.
बाडव a Brahman, यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
A servant, a hired labourer.
